name: ComfyUI
description: A graph-based diffusion workflow engine with its own model loaders, including the rotation-preconditioned int8 and w4a8 weights Comfy-Org publishes for this model. It is a product rather than an API server: the harness drives it through its HTTP API against a fixed workflow, and what is measured is that workflow, not a general serving path.

install.command: git clone https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI && pip install -r requirements.txt

serve.notes: Models are selected inside the workflow, not on the command line, so the workflow JSON is part of the configuration: record which nodes and which files it loaded in args and attach the workflow to the result's raw payload.

notes: The only lane that can load the int8-convrot and w4a8-te weights today, which is the reason it is registered at all. Its timings include workflow overhead a server does not have; say so in provenance.notes rather than comparing them to an HTTP lane without a caveat. versions_available is empty on purpose. A version file has to carry that build's real flags and their real defaults (AGENTS.md), and a wrong default silently merges two configurations into one fingerprint. Nobody has installed this engine for this model yet, so the first run that does reads `--help` on the actual build and adds the version file in the same pull request as its numbers.
